caption: The drawing depicts a single statue of a standing human figure with dark brown or bronze coloration. The figure wears a crown with a jagged edge, and its facial features are prominently detailed, including large eyes, a broad nose, and full lips. The figure has curly hair and a visible earring in the left ear. The figure is dressed in a garment that crosses diagonally over its torso and is secured by a strap on the shoulder. Its right arm is bent at the elbow, with the hand open and palm facing down, while the left arm holds a cylindrical object against its body. The figure stands on a round base of the same color as the statue. The surface of the statue appears worn, with visible marks and slight discoloration in some areas. The background is a flat, light beige color with no additional objects or forms.
title: Tradesman's Sign
